title: QBE Insurance Group Ltd - proposed acquisition of PMI Australia

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: QBE Insurance Group Ltd proposes to acquire PMI Australia.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC did not consider it necessary to reach a definitive view on market definition but is of the view that there are likely to be a range of markets for different insurance products.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC formed the view that the acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant markets. Factors informing this conclusion included: - there was minimal overlap between the operations of the merger parties; and - the acquisition would not provide QBE Insurance Group Ltd with the ability to foreclose competitors in the relevant markets for insurance products.
